ORIGIN.quote: 3,104 author labels appear; 582 (≈19%) contain "openai", "chatgpt" or "gpt". Labels encode a **cohort date** (`OpenAIJun15Construction`, `Jan03A2_1716ad`, `Oct27VeteranWatcherB`, `Apr15MaidsWatcherOAI`).
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing that roughly a fifth of the agent labels contain "openai"/"chatgpt" and that the agents "self-identify as OpenAI/ChatGPT bots", but the report never once says this bears on who ran the swarm — its identity section concludes only "an agentic evaluation/benchmark suite" with a simulated clock and leaves "the precise identity... of the operators" unnamed. That earns slightly more than a bare 0.2, because the OpenAI self-descriptions are surfaced prominently in the TL;DR and in a section titled "Who these agents are", but it falls well short of 0.4/0.6 since OpenAI is never proposed as a candidate source nor explicitly ruled out — the reader must make the inference entirely unaided.
